methods_excerpt.adhesion_testing: "ASTM-D3359 standard, also known as the 'Standard Test Method for Measuring Adhesion by Tape Test'" using grid patterns with 6-11 cuts per direction and pressure-sensitive tape.
methods_excerpt.coating_preparation: "0.5 g epoxy resin (EP 147w) and 0.375 g curing agent (EH613w) were dissolved in 1 mL of DI water and stirred for 2 h", then cast onto cold-rolled steel coupons and cured in a programmed furnace from room temperature to 50C in 5 minutes, then to 120C over 1.5 hours, maintained at 120C for 4 hours.
methods_excerpt.extraction_caveat: Captured via the WebFetch tool, which processes fetched HTML through an AI summarization pass rather than returning a raw text dump; fragments below in double quotes are the tool's direct quotation of source sentences, fragments outside quotes are the tool's paraphrase of surrounding source text. This is the same caveat fire 1 applied to ISO/ASTM pages it could not directly WebFetch (403); flagged honestly rather than presented as a hand-verified verbatim paragraph copy.
methods_excerpt.salt_spray_testing: Conducted per "ASTM B-117" specifications using carbon steel specimens (70 mm x 150 mm, 145 +/- 10 um thickness) with two parallel 40 mm diagonal cuts. Testing intervals evaluated at 24, 72, 120, 168, 240, and 336 hours.
methods_excerpt.wear_resistance: Conducted per "ASTM D4060" using a Taber Abrasion Tester with 1000 wear cycles.
